articles.summary: CATSKILL, N.Y., Oct. 21, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Greene County Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: GCBC), the holding company for the Bank of Greene County and its subsidiary Greene County Commercial Bank, today reported net income for the three months ended September 30, 2025, which is the first quarter of the Company’s fiscal year ending June 30, 2026. articles.title: Greene County Bancorp, Inc. Reports Net Income of $8.9 Million for the Three Months Ended September 30, 2025, and Finalized Expansion Plans into Saratoga County
